title: Check: Similar Shapes: Area and Volume (C)

questions.stem: A model car is built at a scale of $1 : 10$. If the real car has a capacity (volume) of $5000\text{ litres}$, what is the capacity of the model?
questions.explanation: The length scale factor is $\frac{1}{10}$. Volume scales by the cube: $\left(\frac{1}{10}\right)^3 = \frac{1}{1000}$. The model's capacity is $\frac{5000}{1000} = 5\text{ litres}$.
